source_of_truth: text-defects/text_defect_rules.py (this file is generated by `python3 -I text_defect_rules.py rules`)
regex_dialect: Python re and PostgreSQL ARE (identical behaviour; (?i) prefix = case-insensitive)
never: touch a sentence about insurance, liability, coverage, claims or damage
merge, delete or unpublish a record

rules.match: TEXT value that parses as a JSON array of non-empty strings
rules.action: replace the value with the elements joined by ', ' in their original order and spelling (no case change, no added or removed words)

skip.skip: NULL: nothing to do
'[]' would become an empty string: skip and report
skip and report
an element contains a comma, quote, bracket or markup: skip and report
the whole column of the row is left untouched and reported if any sentence the rule would delete, or any narrator sentence in the field, matches

rules.note: Data-side alternative to a renderer fix. If the captured pp-ssr source can render a JSON array as a list, fix the renderer instead and do NOT apply R1 (both together are harmless only if the renderer accepts plain text too).

(pools|pool|options|option|facilities|facility|spots|spot|locations|location|aquatic centers|aquatic center|swimming spots)(?![a-z])
match.count_number_listed: (?i)(?<![a-z0-9.,$])([0-9]+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|single)(?![a-z0-9])( public)? (listed|in our directory|on our site|we list|we track)(?![a-z])
match.count_zero: (?i)((?<![a-z])we (don't|don’t|do not) (currently |yet |really )?(have|list|track|show) any|(?<![a-z])there are no|(?<![a-z])we have no)( public)?( swimming)? (pools|options|facilities|spots|locations)(?![a-z])
match.condition: the sentence states a number of pools for this city's directory (DIRECTORY_SCOPE matches) that differs from count(*) of pp_pools where city_id = the city and is_published (the number the page header prints)

rules.action: delete the sentence (the number is never rewritten)
rules.automatic_only_if: category 'auto': no insurance word; no sub-type word between number and noun; no other number, URL, amenity, price or schedule word and no claim verb (COUNT_CLAIM: (?i)(?<![a-z])(offers?|offering|features?|includes?|including|requires?|known|designed|family-friendly|kid-friendly|caters?|geared|specializ[a-z]*|famous|plus|covering|ranging|ranges?|everything|variety|mix|types?|kinds?|sizes?|across)(?![a-z])) in the rest of the sentence; stated count differs from the distinct-facility count after mapped duplicates

listed_not_automatic.review_mixed: wrong directory count plus other claims
listed_not_automatic.hold_duplicate: stated count equals the facility count once mapped duplicates (duplicate-mapping.csv SAME_FACILITY / LIKELY_SAME) are merged
listed_not_automatic.vague: (?i)(?<![a-z])(a couple|a few|a handful|several|a decent number|a good number|plenty)( of)?( [a-z-]+){0,2}? (pools|options|facilities|spots|listed)(?![a-z])

skip.skip: the whole column of the row is left untouched and reported if any sentence the rule would delete, or any narrator sentence in the field, matches
row (for this column) is skipped and reported if the first kept sentence after a deleted one matches (it would point back at a deleted sentence)

row (for this column) is skipped and reported if a deleted sentence that is not the last kept context contains a capitalised word other than its first word, I-forms, the pool name, the city name or the state name
row (for this column) is skipped and reported if every sentence of a field would be deleted

the whole column (a description, an intro, or the whole ai_faqs array, R5 included) is left unchanged and reported as ALL:joined_clause_kept if the rules would change it and any of its sentences is decided differently because of joined_clause_pattern: a narrator sentence deletable with core_pattern but kept with the full pattern, a generic referral non-informative with core_pattern but not with the full pattern, or an R6 count sentence 'auto' with core_pattern but not with the full pattern.
